Use Trek Central to adjust how the assist from your motor feels. Adjust Max Power, Assist Factor, and Pedal Response to optimize YOUR ride. HOW FAR WILL YOU GO? 

See how far your Trek or Electra eBike will take you with real-time range calculations.
